title: Kutaurwa Kuva Munhu
intro: Munhu anobuda munhoroondo tsvene, akatakura zvishamiso zvaipesana nehurongwa hwechisikigo. Mweya uyu wakasvika kuburikidza nemurairo mumwe chete waMwari, wakadzivirira mubereki kubva pakupomerwa kwakakomba, uye wakasiya nyika ino vasati vasungwa nengetani dzepanyika. Nyaya yacho inotangira paucheche hwakaderera kusvika kumatenga ari kumusoro. Angave ani uyu?
clues: Ndakatumwa sechiratidzo netsitsi kubva kuna Allah kuvana veIsraeri.
Kusvika kwangu kwakanga kwakasiyana nekupi zvako kare — ndakavapo neshoko raMwari rokuti 'Iva!' ndisina baba vepanyika.
Mubereki wangu akatarisana nekunyombwa zvine hutsinye, asi zvakazarurwa zvitsvene zvakaburuka kuti zvizivise kusava nemhosva kwavo uye zvivasimudzire.
Semwana mucheche achangoberekwa, ndakashamisa vanhu vaiva pedyo neni nekutaura zvakajeka kubva paucheche hwangu kuti ndichenese zita remubereki wangu.
Nemvumo yaAllah, ndakaumba hupenyu kubva muvhu risina upenyu, ndakapa mapofu kuona, uye ndakarapa maperembudzi nekubata kwangu.
Ndakasimudzwa kudenga ndisati ndabatwa nenjodzi, uye ndichadzoka panyika ino nguva yekupedzisira isati yasvika.

arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
verse: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water. (23:50)
